During the [[Tionese War]], a '''farm''' was maintained on [[the Divide]] astronomical object [[Okator VIII]] by the [[Parent/Legends|parents]] of a young [[Unidentified Republic soldier (Falang Minor)|boy]]. The [[Farm/Legends|farm]] was eventually destroyed during an [[attack on Okator VIII]] by a group of [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] [[Tionjack|warships]].<ref name="Author's Cut" />
